params.name: account_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the Cloudflare account.

params.name: model
params.description: The model identifier to execute, e.g. @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct.

items.docs: Run an AI model on Cloudflare's global network. The model parameter specifies which model to invoke from the Workers AI catalog. Supports text generation, text-to-image, image classification, speech-to-text, translation, summarization, and embedding models.
